source: 40 individually authored fictional customer-support decision scenarios
author: Codex assistant
review: Author semantic review, separate blind assistant review, and additional no-parent-history semantic review accept all 40 gold outcomes; not human annotation.
blindness: Author and second reviewer did not inspect revised v0.5 implementation, prompt instructions, model outputs or final-model selection. Historical inputs and broad failure categories were known. Implementers must not inspect this holdout or review ledger before source/model/settings freeze.

predefined_composition.ordering: Deterministic shuffle, seed 503, independent of model behavior.

usage: Compare the frozen prior v0.4 and revised CPU systems once each on all 40 unchanged cases, with documented matched settings and intentional model/backend differences. Keep original and accepted-final decisions separate.
holdout_policy: No prompt, model-selection, grounding or unit-test tuning on these cases. Preserve every failure and original raw output. After evaluation this set is seen. Further tuning requires development data and a new final test set.
isolation: Disjoint exact and reference/number-normalized templates from 112 earlier smoke, practice, portfolio-v1 and portfolio-v2 inputs; unique example/family/scenario IDs. Structural checks do not establish semantic independence.
limitations: Small targeted English-only fictional set; not sampled production traffic.
Two assistant review passes are not independent human annotation.
Difficulty is descriptive assistant judgment rather than empirical calibration.
Known broad reasoning concepts recur despite new prompts and identifiers.
Gold uses canonical tool contracts only; no order-store membership, ID regex, refund cap, eligibility policy, payment execution or currency conversion.
Clarification-question helpfulness is not human graded by canonical strict scoring.

additional_review_provenance.semantic_reviewer_context: fork_turns=none; canonical contracts and data only; no revised implementation or outputs inspected
additional_review_provenance.coordinator_role: Inherited implementation context; structural/hash checks only
